phase1_assignment.objective: Audit generic reproducible agent-lifecycle patterns for durable evidence, provenance, continuation, verification and handoff of only irreducible exclusive actions.

observations.mechanism: verifier-derived terminal status instead of agent-authored completion
observations.evidence: FrontierChallenge reports that each best configuration completed only 20/97 released end-to-end scientific workflows (20.6% pass rate), while 75.5% of non-passing Claude Code trajectories still ended with language claiming completion. This directly separates natural-language completion claims from complete artifact delivery.
observations.scope: 97 released workflows across six scientific areas; completion-claim statistic is for non-passing Claude Code trajectories in that benchmark.

observations.mechanism: revision-scoped immutable evidence with idempotent replay and stale-head rejection
observations.evidence: The current public SENPAI implementation records a falsifiable assignment with required research-base SHA, baseline, scope and stopping rules; structured results carry exact result commit plus W&B run IDs/URLs and bounded conclusions; once published for an assignment revision and head, identical publication is an idempotent replay while changed evidence requires a new commit or revision. Exact assignment/revision/head/branch-lease preconditions detect stale work, and an incomplete persisted tool action is rejected on restart rather than replayed implicitly.
observations.scope: Public SENPAI research harness implementation/contract as observed 2026-08-28; implementation pattern evidence, not a matched causal ablation of each durability mechanism.

observations.mechanism: durable continuation from persisted checkpoints/event history
observations.evidence: LangGraph documents checkpointers for thread-scoped graph-state snapshots supporting interruption recovery and fault tolerance, while persistent stores carry cross-thread data; its in-memory saver explicitly does not survive restart. Temporal documents durable workflow execution recovered from persisted event history by deterministic replay, with commands checked against that history and recovery from the last recorded event.
observations.scope: General workflow/runtime mechanisms; not specific evidence that any one scientific-agent benchmark improves from these primitives.

observations.mechanism: obligation-bound handoff packet that protects evaluator-facing artifact details
observations.evidence: Scientific-RAM defines a source-grounded bounded handoff packet with protected contract, artifact surface, obligations and sufficiency status, plus provenance-bearing selected evidence and repair evidence for unsupported slots. Its reported conclusion is targeted: such packets help obligation-sensitive handoffs but are not a universal substitute for full context or stronger downstream agents.
observations.scope: Research-agent handoff experiments reported by a 2026 OpenReview submission; supporting evidence, not a universal handoff law.

observations.mechanism: reproduction hook must test executable fidelity, not only textual similarity
observations.evidence: AutoReproduce (ACL 2026) builds paper-lineage retrieval plus sampling-based unit tests and evaluates both reproduction and execution fidelity against verified implementations; the paper reports improvements over agent baselines across its metrics. This supports attaching executable tests and lineage to research artifacts before treating them as reproduced.
observations.scope: AI experiment reproduction benchmark; does not by itself establish physical-science reproducibility.

inferences.proposal: Use an evidence-carrying lifecycle object whose terminal state is computed by verification, not declared by the agent. Minimum fields: stable task/revision identity; source/base SHA; claim; executable artifact URI/hash; environment/dependency record; dataset/input identity; metric definition; run IDs; verification command and result; bounded conclusion; unresolved obligations; exact continuation.

Make result publication revision-scoped and immutable. Exact replay with the same revision/head/evidence digest should be idempotent; changed evidence must create a new revision. Reject stale-head publication and reject implicit replay of an interrupted side-effecting action.

Treat negative/abandoned branches as first-class evidence: preserve the exact artifact/commit, run IDs, failure signal, scope-limited conclusion and reason for closure so later agents can distinguish tested failure from unexplored space. SENPAI's public workflow explicitly allows closing a useful negative result and preserves divergent local history for reconciliation.

Handoff should be obligation-bound and authority-minimal: transfer responsibility only when the next actor has a capability or authority the current actor cannot safely exercise. The packet should name that exclusive action, preconditions, current revision/head, artifact surface, verified completed obligations, unresolved slots, idempotency/rollback contract and exact return evidence required. This exclusive-action restriction is a synthesis from role-bounded typed tools plus RAM-style obligation packets; it is not yet directly benchmarked as an isolated mechanism.

reproducibility_acceptance_criteria: CLAIM_ARTIFACT_SEPARATION: every nontrivial research claim is linked to a concrete executable or inspectable artifact, or explicitly marked unverified.
SOURCE_QUALIFICATION: every externally derived claim carries a source URL/version or immutable source identifier and tested scope.
REVISION_IDENTITY: code/data/config/environment/result are bound to an immutable revision or content digest.
EXECUTABLE_VERIFICATION: at least one machine-executable verification hook is recorded with command/input/result; prose-only confirmation is insufficient.
TERMINAL_STATUS_GATE: complete/verified status is derived from the required deliverable bundle and checks; agent language claiming completion cannot set terminal success.
DURABLE_CONTINUATION: stable run/task identity plus persistent checkpoint/event history is sufficient to resume after process loss without depending on hidden model memory.
NO_IMPLICIT_SIDE_EFFECT_REPLAY: an interrupted external mutation is reconciled or rejected before retry; duplicate publication is idempotent under an explicit key/revision.
NEGATIVE_BRANCH_RETENTION: failed or abandoned branches preserve artifact/evidence/reason and remain addressable rather than disappearing from lineage.
HANDOFF_SUFFICIENCY: packet explicitly lists downstream obligations, evaluator-facing artifact surface, missing slots, provenance-bearing evidence and exact requested action.
EXCLUSIVE_ACTION_JUSTIFICATION: any handoff names the capability/authority unavailable to the sender; if no such irreducible boundary exists, sender should continue rather than hand off prematurely.
unverified_claims: No matched study was found in this short pre-drift window isolating the causal effect of authority-minimal/exclusive-action handoff versus ordinary role handoff in scientific agents.
No matched study was found in this short pre-drift window isolating preservation of abandoned/negative branches as the sole cause of downstream research improvement.
The proposed combined lifecycle contract is a synthesis across public scientific-agent systems and durable-workflow infrastructure; its integrated effect is not yet directly tested.
